item.name: Authentication
item.description: Identity and session management endpoints.

item.name: Register
item.description: Creates a new user account with the specified role. Returns user ID and verification status. An OTP is sent to the provided email address.

item.name: Verify Email
item.description: Verifies the user's email address using the 6-digit OTP sent during registration.

item.name: Resend Verification OTP
item.description: Resends the email verification OTP to the specified address. The previous OTP is invalidated.

item.name: Login
item.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token in the response body. A refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie named `refreshToken`.

item.name: Refresh Token
item.description: Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. Requires the `refreshToken` HttpOnly cookie to be present. Returns 401 and clears the cookie on failure.

item.name: Logout
item.description: Blacklists the current access token and revokes the refresh token cookie. Sends a Set-Cookie header to clear the client-side cookie.

item.name: Get Current User
item.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user, including role and verification status.

item.name: Forgot Password
item.description: Initiates the password reset flow. If the email is registered, a 6-digit OTP is sent. Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration.

item.name: Verify Reset OTP
item.description: Verifies the password reset OTP and returns a short-lived reset token used in the subsequent reset-password call.

item.name: Reset Password
item.description: Resets the user's password using the reset token obtained from the verify-reset-otp endpoint.

item.name: Exchange OAuth2 Code
item.description: Exchanges an OAuth2 authorization code (from Google or Microsoft) for a UniHub access token and refresh cookie.

item.name: Account
item.description: Account lifecycle management.

item.name: Delete Account
item.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account. Requires the current password for confirmation. Revokes all tokens and clears the refresh cookie.

item.name: Student
item.description: Endpoints accessible to users with the STUDENT role.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Student own-profile management.

item.name: Get My Profile

item.name: Set University
item.description: Associates the student's profile with a university and major. This operation can only be performed once; subsequent calls are rejected.

item.name: Update Skills
item.description: Replaces the student's current skill set with the supplied list of skill IDs. Pass an empty set to clear all skills.

item.name: Upload Profile Photo
item.description: Uploads or replaces the student's profile photo. Accepts `multipart/form-data` with a field named `file`. Returns the public URL of the stored image.

item.name: Upload Graduation Certificate
item.description: Submits a graduation certificate file for review by the student's university. Accepts `multipart/form-data` with a field named `file`. Returns the certificate record with initial PENDING status.

item.name: Get Certificate Status
item.description: Returns the current status of the authenticated student's graduation certificate submission.

item.name: WebSocket — Send Message
item.description:
WebSocket endpoint using STOMP over SockJS.

**Connection URL:** `ws://{{wsHost}}/ws`  
**Send destination:** `/app/chat.send`  
**Subscribe (receive):** `/user/queue/messages`  

The STOMP payload must be a JSON object matching the schema below:
```json
{
  "receiverId": "<UUID>",
  "content": "Hello!"
}
```
Authentication is passed via the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header during the STOMP `CONNECT` handshake.

item.name: Update Preferences
